# Universal splitting-kernel reference

Primary source: https://github.com/vbertone/apfelxx/tree/27deaec493d95bad0686b3b1c91fbbc910c891ff/src/evolution

Pinned APFEL++ commit 27deaec493d95bad0686b3b1c91fbbc910c891ff. These are reference formulas and independently executable comparison inputs for universal splitting kernels. They are not SIDIS hard coefficients. Only the NLO splitting terms are needed for NNLO mass factorization; do not use the approximate higher-order terms accidentally.
